=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is the uncropped Facebook photograph posted 11 September 2013. The Facebook photo viewer names Stephen Michael. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (group member since 11 October 2009). Gold 115 Monroe, Georgia. The photograph is already a single-subject studio headshot, so it is not cropped. Comments address him as Stephen; Janice Michael writes that he is her husband. Do not dest Michael Stephen Furman. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Stephen Michael portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Stephen Michael Facebook portrait.jpg]].
